# Test with original code - proper escaping using raw string
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', r'''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import get_name, stashedHTML2text, unescape

md_text = """[TOC]

# `<test>`
"""
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc"])

# Parse manually to see tree
lines = md_text.strip().split("\n")
tree = md.parser.parseDocument(lines)

for el in tree.iter():
    if el.tag == 'h1':
        print(f"el.text: {repr(el.text)}")
        print(f"itertext: {list(el.itertext())}")
        name = get_name(el)
        print(f"get_name result: {repr(name)}")
        
        # What does stashedHTML2text do?
        sht = stashedHTML2text(name, md)
        print(f"stashedHTML2text: {repr(sht)}")
        
        # What does unescape do?
        u = unescape(sht)
        print(f"unescape: {repr(u)}")
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-300:])
